item.title: Two Google alumni raise $11.3M to back AI startups that enterprises will actually pay for
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: BAG Ventures announces close of a $11.3M Fund I to invest in all things AI.

item.title: Airbnb adds AI search, more social features
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Airbnb is also launching new services such as meal delivery and laundry in select locations

item.title: Apple Pay finally launches in India after years on the sidelines
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Some of India's largest banks are holding off on supporting Apple Pay initially.

item.title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it’s not a glitch
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: For the sake of national security, it's a relief to learn that America.gov is not hallucinating to the point that it's penning lengthy poetry.

item.title: The internet is convinced Elon Musk’s xAI trolled OpenAI’s ‘Dots’ launch
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Before OpenAI launched its new AI agent, Dots, on Tuesday, Elon Musk's xAI had already acquired the domain name "dot.com," which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page.

item.title: Your car and its mobile app are probably handing over all kinds of data to tech companies
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Researchers at Northeastern University found vehicles and their companion apps regularly shared detailed data with some of the largest tech companies.

item.title: a16z-backed EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation to $4B
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: EliseAI raises $350M, doubles valuation in a year.

item.title: Tesla secures $30B in new credit lines as it looks to scale Cybercab, Optimus
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The company says it won't draw on the new debt facilities this year, as it has already planned at least $25 billion in capital expenditures.

item.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

item.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The new round is anticipated to be the company's last before its delayed 2027 public debut.

item.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.

item.title: OpenAI takes on Microsoft with the launch of what feels a whole lot like ChatGPT’s own office suite
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: OpenAI's newly announced suite of office features puts it into more direct competition with more traditional software companies.

item.title: Dutch police arrest ShinyHunters hacker accused of planning two murders
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Dutch police said the hacker, arrested for being part of the ShinyHunters cybercriminal gang, had plans to organize the murder of two people on his laptop.

item.title: AI-powered app maker Wabi pivots to a messaging experience
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Wabi is repositioning its prompt-based app builder as a personal AI agent that can create interfaces on demand, combining chat, apps, and ongoing tasks.

item.title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Dots are meant to operate independent of any specific hardware or interface, pursuing user-defined goals continuously in the background with minimal oversight.

item.title: OpenAI gives Codex reusable cloud environments that work across devices
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud development environments, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools, and a security-focused product for scanning repositories and preparing fixes.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol delivers significant improvements over GPT-6 Sol across complex professional tasks, including code writing and debugging, document understanding, and executing multistep business workflows.

item.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plug-ins with app-like interfaces and automations
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT plug-ins with dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, improved discovery, and support for automations.

item.title: Can a chatbot fix the government maze? The White House is about to find out
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: America.gov is intended to simplify the process of navigating government bureaucracy, but large language models are imperfect and remain prone to hallucinations, which could cause new issues.
